title: Operating-system command executed through :os.cmd in elixir — review required
description: :os.cmd passes its charlist or string to the system shell. A value interpolated into it is parsed as shell syntax, so metacharacters append commands running with the BEAM node identity. The rule flags the call; whether the value is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Use System.cmd/3 with an argument list and validate dynamic values, or a port with an explicit executable.
limitation: Lexical: matches :os.cmd calls; System.cmd with separate arguments is out of scope and is the safer form.
